tasks.title: Confirm `move-to-admin-settings` (#1) is applied — the app mounts inside Settings → Administration (no top-nav/page route)
Confirm `codeberg-forge-support` (#2) is applied — `forge` field on SourceBinding/Pat, codeberg source registered, forge-qualified allowlist patterns, forge-aware token validation/deeplink

Add `addTrustedPattern(string $forge, string $owner, ?string $repo): void` to `lib/Service/InstallerService.php` — construct `{forge}:{owner}/{repo}` (or `{forge}:{owner}/*` when repo is null), validate, append to existing patterns, persist via `TrustedSourceList::setPatterns()`
Add `removeTrustedPattern(string $pattern): void` to `InstallerService` — remove the exact pattern from the current set and persist via `setPatterns()`

Implement over-broad-glob validation in `InstallerService` (adr-008 layering): reject unknown forge; empty or `*`-only owner; resulting patterns `*`, `*/*`, `{forge}:*`; owner/repo not matching `[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+`. Throw a typed/`InvalidArgumentException` with a clear message

Add `POST /api/trusted-sources` to `lib/Controller/ApiController.php` — admin-gated, `#[PasswordConfirmationRequired(strict: false)]`, body `{forge, owner, repo?}`; map validation failures to HTTP 400/422, success returns the updated `trustedPatterns`

Add `DELETE /api/trusted-sources/{pattern}` to `ApiController` — admin-gated, password-confirmed; pattern is a URL-encoded path param (client percent-encodes the `/` and `:`), decoded server-side before matching; ensure the route captures the encoded segment intact; returns the updated `trustedPatterns`
Confirm listing reuses existing `GET /api/sources` `trustedPatterns` (no dedicated GET added)
Unit test: curated add of `{forge:codeberg, owner:Conduction, repo:openregister}` persists `codeberg:Conduction/openregister`
Unit test: owner-only add persists `{forge}:owner/*`
Unit test: dangerous globs rejected — `*`, `*/*`, `{forge}:*`, empty owner, owner `*`, unknown forge, bad charset
Unit test: remove deletes exactly the given pattern and persists
Unit test: non-admin gets HTTP 403 from both write endpoints and the allowlist is unchanged
In `src/App.vue` replace `NcContent`/`NcAppContent` with a settings-section container that renders cleanly inside the admin Settings panel
Add an in-component tab/section switcher (Apps / Sources / Tokens / Trusted sources) with `currentTab` state; default to Apps
Wrap the existing apps → versions → install view as the Apps tab, preserving its current behaviour
Create `src/components/SourcesPanel.vue`; on app select, show current binding from `GET /api/source/{appId}/binding`
Add bind form: forge select (github|codeberg from `GET /api/sources` `listAvailable`), owner, repo, optional assetPattern → `POST /api/source/{appId}/bind` (password-confirmed)
On successful bind, refresh the binding display and the app's version list
Create `src/components/TokensPanel.vue`; list redacted PATs from `GET /api/pats`
Add-token form: forge select, label, target (owner [+ optional repo] → derived `targetPattern`), token field → `POST /api/pats`
Edit label / share toggle → `PATCH /api/pats/{id}`; delete → `DELETE /api/pats/{id}` (both password-confirmed)
Per-forge "create a token" button → `GET /api/pats/deeplink?forge=…`; show returned url + instructions
Create `src/components/TrustedSourcesPanel.vue`; list current forge-qualified patterns from `GET /api/sources` `trustedPatterns`
Curated add: forge select + owner [+ optional repo], explicit "I trust this source" confirmation → `POST /api/trusted-sources` (password-confirmed)
Surface backend rejection messages (e.g. `*/*` refused) in the UI via NcNoteCard
Remove a pattern → `DELETE /api/trusted-sources/{pattern}` with the URL-encoded pattern (password-confirmed); refresh the list
Use standard NC Vue components (NcButton, NcTextField, NcSelect, NcCheckboxRadioSwitch, NcDialog, NcNoteCard); no hardcoded colors; WCAG AA
Wrap all new user-facing strings in `t('app_versions', …)` (adr-005)
Frontend mount/render check if a harness exists; at minimum ensure the app compiles with `vite build`
